mintAuthority.summary: NUSD's only native issuance is the Ethereum Synapse nexus-pool LPToken: mint is restricted to its SwapFlashLoan pool owner, and supply expands when LPs add liquidity. Both token and pool are fixed EIP-1167 clones. At Ethereum block 26098746, the pool owner was a 2-of-3 Safe with no enabled modules, guard or module guard. The twelve non-Ethereum SynapseERC20 deployments are bridge representations and are assessed under Bridge Risk.

controls.label: Synapse SwapFlashLoan pool (sole NUSD minter)
controls.capDescription: Only onlyOwner can call mint() on the LPToken; the sole owner is the SwapFlashLoan pool; minting occurs only when LPs add liquidity. There is no independent fixed supply cap, so the native path is bounded by pool deposit/accounting logic. Pool ownership is held by the separately reviewed 2-of-3 Safe.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770804 (2026-08-16), NUSD token 0x1b84765de8b7566e4ceaf4d0fd3c5af52d3dde4f remained the fixed LPToken clone and owner() returned SwapFlashLoan pool 0x1116898dda4015ed8ddefb84b6e8bc24528af2d8. The LPToken mint() path is onlyOwner and new shares require liquidity deposited into the pool; the pool's owner is the 2-of-3 Safe 0x67f60b0891ebd842ebe55e4ccca1098d7aac1a55.

controls.label: Synapse nexus-pool admin Safe (pool owner)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26098746 (2026-10-01), SwapFlashLoan pool owner() returned Safe 0x67f60b0891ebd842ebe55e4ccca1098d7aac1a55. getOwners() returned three owners and getThreshold() returned 2. getModulesPaginated(0x1,100) returned an empty list and terminal sentinel 0x1; guard and module-guard slots were zero. VERSION() returned 1.4.1 and the fallback handler was 0xfd0732dc9e303f09fcef3a7388ad10a83459ec99. The earlier August 16 observation recorded an enabled Allowance Module and version 1.3.0; neither describes the current Safe state. This observation does not alter the reviewed immutable, pool-deposit/accounting-driven issuance path.

capSemanticsReview.rationale: D14 review 2026-10-03: verified fixed Swap/SwapUtils and LPToken implementations show that pool-owned LPToken.mint is reachable only from addLiquidity after safeTransferFrom of pooled assets and invariant-based share calculation. Pool admin fee/amplification powers do not expose arbitrary token mint, transfer its LPToken ownership, or replace either fixed clone target. Bounded-by-construction review retained; October 1 Safe evidence supersedes historical module configuration.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25770804 (2026-08-16), NUSD LPToken 0x1b84765de8b7566e4ceaf4d0fd3c5af52d3dde4 and SwapFlashLoan pool 0x1116898dda4015ed8ddefb84b6e8bc24528af2d8 were 45-byte EIP-1167 runtimes embedding fixed implementations 0x6c8c6e68604e78b549c96907bfe9ebdaac04e3b3 and 0x5a5fff6f753d7c11a56a52fe47a177a87e431655. All EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots were zero on both clones and implementations. Pool ownership remained with the 2-of-3 Safe; its enabled Allowance Module can transfer Safe-held allowances but cannot change either clone target. NUSD is the fixed pool's LP receipt: new shares require liquidity deposited into the immutable SwapFlashLoan clone, and neither the pool owner nor its Safe can replace the LPToken or pool implementation. The native direct-mint path is therefore economically bounded by deposited pool assets. The twelve non-Ethereum SynapseERC20 deployments are bridge representations with route-scoped MINTER_ROLE controls under Bridge Risk; their bridge role administration is not counted as native Mint Authority. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-16: the immutable Ethereum pool remains bounded, but the reviewed reserve reconciliation does not establish coverage for all satellite deployments and no prudential supervisor applies. Wave 2 external verification 2026-08-15: Synapse pool and bridge documentation did not establish aggregate monitoring or independent reconciliation across every satellite NUSD mint path. D14 review 2026-10-03: verified fixed Swap/SwapUtils and LPToken implementations show that pool-owned LPToken.mint is reachable only from addLiquidity after safeTransferFrom of pooled assets and invariant-based share calculation. Pool admin fee/amplification powers do not expose arbitrary token mint, transfer its LPToken ownership, or replace either fixed clone target. Bounded-by-construction review retained; October 1 Safe evidence supersedes historical module configuration.
